description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableJsonString' representing a JSON string with proper escaping. It provides methods for creating instances, checking types, conversion to string, equality, and serialization handling.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonString
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON string with proper escaping, providing utility methods for handling JSON string values.

methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutableJsonString instance from a non-null Java String.
